item.title: Rolling Forcing: Streaming World Models That Stay Put
item.description: arXiv:2609.11111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a causal autoregressive video generation model that consumes a per-step action and keeps an explicit spatial memory, so revisiting a place does not resample it.

item.title: Person Re-Identification Under Severe Occlusion
item.description: arXiv:2609.22222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We match pedestrian images across disjoint camera views using a transformer backbone and a part-aware matching loss on three surveillance benchmarks.

item.title: A Sparse Attention Kernel for Video Diffusion Transformers
item.description: arXiv:2609.33333v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video diffusion is bottlenecked by attention. We sparsify it and reach 24 fps at 480p without retraining the base model.

item.title: Interactive Video Generation, Revised
item.description: arXiv:2601.44444v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An earlier interactive video world model, now with more experiments.
